items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk wants to merge SpaceX and Tesla into a $3.4 trillion giant. The problem: it would lose money from day one
items.summary_cn: 马斯克考虑将SpaceX与特斯拉合并成3.4万亿美元巨头，但分析指出该交易从第一天起就会亏损。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Turns Out, Tesla's Best Cybertruck Customer Is SpaceX
items.summary_cn: SpaceX是特斯拉Cybertruck的最佳客户，显示特斯拉与SpaceX业务协同。

items.author: Musk
items.text: A SpaceX/Tesla merger could trigger Musk’s $1T pay package automatically
items.summary_cn: SpaceX与特斯拉合并可能自动触发马斯克的1万亿美元薪酬方案。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX’s IPO Forces Wall Street to Reorganize Around It
items.summary_cn: SpaceX IPO迫使华尔街围绕其重组，但SpaceX未上市，不直接涉及可交易标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: As SpaceX IPO nears, traders think it's a near-certainty Musk becomes the first trillionaire
items.summary_cn: 随着SpaceX IPO临近，交易员认为马斯克成为首位万亿富翁几乎已成定局，但SpaceX未上市。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Says Economy Cannot Function Without Prices: Tesla And SpaceX CEO Shares Stinging Critique Of Socialist Central Planning
items.summary_cn: 马斯克批评社会主义中央计划，强调价格机制对经济运行的必要性。
